today.q: How transferable are InVEST models and ecosystem service frameworks from data-rich contexts to semi-arid Kabul?
outline: Discuss transferability between cities and contexts
Address semi-arid, mountainous, and data-scarce conditions
Explain adaptations needed for peri-urban agriculture and hillsides
today.pitfall: Assuming standard parameterizations work universally without local calibration.
today.follow_up: How do plural values and governance contexts alter model transportability?
today.bring: Literature references or comparative criteria for cross-city transferability.
